say: No mobile signal, and you need help.
How can a text still reach rescuers?
With a supported phone and country, it goes via satellite.
Your phone sends a short text up to a satellite,
which passes it down to a ground station, then to a response centre.
Unlike a nearby tower, the satellite is far away: aim at open sky, expect slower replies.
